entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it a little over a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a defect. The pulse readings are all over the place. One minute it says my heart rate is 50, the next it's 190 while I'm just sitting here. The main feature is completely unreliable. Honestly, it's garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear the device isn't performing as expected. That sounds frustrating. I can try to walk you through a few troubleshooting steps, or I can transfer you to our technical support team who are experts with this.
I appreciate that, but I don't have time to go through all of that. I've already tried resetting it. At this point, I just want my money back. Can we please process a refund?
I understand you'd prefer a straightforward return. Let me just pull up your order details and review our policy. Can you confirm the email address on your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 37 days ago. Let me just check the policy here... and... yes, it looks good.
So you can process the return?
Absolutely. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. I can process that for you right now.
Oh, that's fantastic. I was expecting a bit of a fight. Thank you for making that so easy.

Of course. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble you've had with this device, I'd like to add a $25 credit to your account for a future purchase, as a thank you for your loyalty to VeloFit.
Wow, that's not necessary, but thank you very much. I appreciate it.

You are most welcome. I've just sent the prepaid return label to your email. Please attach it to the original packaging, and your refund will be processed once we receive the item. Was there anything else I could help with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help, Diana.
Happy to assist. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
